newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 7.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Education Minister Claude Allegre pledges to hire 40,000 young people in education jobs paid close to the minimum wage. The state would bear 80 percent on the cost and local administrations the rest.
-- EDF utility to diversify into generating electricity from coal, gas or a combination of both, in order to win new markets where prospects for nuclear energy are limited.
